name: Terminal Happiness
source:
The story passes in a far away hospital, away from civilization, that has a dark glassbox around it.
The game features the lives of Lai, an albino who can't be exposed to the sun and lives in the hospital because
the sun is covered by the dark glass and therefore she is allowed to live a fairly normal life.
And Rei, a patient of the surgery side of the building who can't have a surgery.
Will Lai be able to make Rei's live less miserably?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21251&sid=69711a513fcea31ae16131476508262f]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一所远离文明的偏僻医院，医院四周被深色玻璃罩包围。
游戏讲述了莱和蕾的生活。莱是一名白化病患者，无法暴露在阳光下。由于阳光被深色玻璃罩遮挡，她住在这所医院里，也因此能够过上相对正常的生活。蕾则是医院外科区域的一名患者，无法接受手术。
莱能让蕾的生活不再那么悲惨吗？

[来自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21251&sid=69711a513fcea31ae16131476508262f]Lemma Soft 论坛[/url]]
